title: Geologic Map of the Ropers Crossroads Quadrangle, Edgefield and Aiken Counties, South Carolina
citation: Wilson, C.G., Morrow, R.H., and Willoughby, R.H., 2024, Geologic Map of the Ropers Crossroads Quadrangle, Edgefield and Aiken Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 266, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet with a text layer (page 1); pages 2-4 are an unrelated FGDC symbol-style note bundled in the download and were not recorded. Symbol-description pairing checked on page images of the legend and correlation chart (Qal, Qcb, Tb, Ttr, Tdb, Th, UKs). Ages of Qal, Qcb and UKs taken from their names (inferred). The many strike/dip, lineation and fold-hinge numbers on the map face have no printed locations and were not recorded; legend-only symbols (Augusta fault zone trace, fault types, field stations) not recorded. 15 SCDNR well-log locations labelled on the map face (19-21 also the legend sample); no logs printed. 'S-19' labels on the map face are not explained in the legend and were not recorded. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
